snippet.title: Multiplayer Indie Game Reveal Trailer (Steam/PC) | Sheep for the Stars
snippet.description:
High stakes rocket-powered precision sheep platformer. As a sheep strapped to a rocket, boost up and climb through perilous terrain and traps to reach the goal before everyone else. Every sheep has dreamed of touching the stars, will you be the first?

Early Access Demo available on Steam! Feedback welcome.

Sheep for the Stars | Made for PC and Steam Deck by Ace High Arcade
Wishlist or Try Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520580?utm_source=YT

Indie Game Reveal Trailer (Steam/PC), featuring a new up and coming indie game releasing in 2025.
